source.title: Intel 1986 Microsystem Components Handbook, Volume I
source.inspection: Embedded text and rendered table, load circuits, waveforms and capacitance curves inspected.

profile: Commercial 8282/8283; separate preliminary extended-temperature EXPRESS maxima. Not the AFN-01413B industrial contract.
finding: The general timing reference remains 1.5 V, also the released-load bias. The waveform labels disable departures but no separate enable threshold. This later revision does not resolve that ambiguity.
independentEvidence: Output-delay versus capacitance curves are supplied for 8282 and 8283. Their commercial load/profile context cannot silently replace industrial constraints.
decision: Keep enable unqualified. Do not transfer commercial or EXPRESS limits, plastic-package loading, switching load or NEC departure thresholds to I8282. New evidence must distinguish the enable measurement convention or explicitly qualify another reference family.
